splunk:
sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventSource="bedrock.amazonaws.com" eventName IN ("InvokeModel", "InvokeModelWithResponseStream", "Converse", "ConverseStream") NOT userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/allowlisted-multi-region-inference/*"

| bin _time span=1h
| stats dc(awsRegion) as value_count by _time userIdentity.arn

| search value_count >= 3
esql:
from logs-aws.cloudtrail-* metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.provider=="bedrock.amazonaws.com" and (event.action in ("InvokeModel", "InvokeModelWithResponseStream", "Converse", "ConverseStream")) and not starts_with(aws.cloudtrail.user_identity.arn, "arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/allowlisted-multi-region-inference/")
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1hours, @timestamp) | stats value_count=count_distinct(cloud.region) by timebucket, aws.cloudtrail.user_identity.arn
| where value_count >= 3
sqlite: SELECT `userIdentity.arn`, COUNT(DISTINCT awsRegion) AS value_count FROM (SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (eventSource='bedrock.amazonaws.com' AND (eventName='InvokeModel' OR eventName='InvokeModelWithResponseStream' OR eventName='Converse' OR eventName='ConverseStream')) AND (NOT `userIdentity.arn` LIKE 'arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/allowlisted-multi-region-inference/%' ESCAPE '\')) AS subquery GROUP BY `userIdentity.arn` HAVING value_count >= 3
